now.title: Moon Knight
now.text: In episode 3, when Anton Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus, Marc spears him through the chest.

proposed.text: In episode 3, when Anton Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus and charges Layla on horseback, Marc hits him in the back with a crescent blade and he rides off wounded.

changes.evidence: In episode 3 (The Friendly Type), Marc throws a crescent blade into Mogart's back as Mogart tries to trample Layla, and Mogart rides away crying out in pain. He is not speared through the chest, and the episode never shows or confirms his death (fandom lists his status as Unknown), so Deceased is wrong (F3 as well).

now.title: Luke Cage S2
now.text: In episode 8, Luke protects his father, Pastor James Lucas, from Bushmaster's men, and the two begin to reconcile.

proposed.text: In episode 9, Luke protects his father, Pastor James Lucas, from Bushmaster's men, and the two begin to reconcile.

changes.evidence: Luke protects his father at the church in episode 8, but the reconciliation, the record's last event, happens in episode 9 (For Pete's Sake): 'Cage begins to reconcile with his father', after the hideout fight where they talk and hug before James returns to Georgia.
